### Shipping for an approved claim

For an approved claim the company pays shipping both ways. The customer receives a prepaid UPS
Ground label addressed to:

Lantern Supply Co. Repair Center
1180 Downsville Pike, Dock B
Hagerstown, MD 21740

The product must be packed in a box with enough padding that it does not move. Fuel lanterns and
oil lamps must be completely drained and left open to air for 24 hours before packing; the
Repair Center refuses any package that smells of fuel, and the carrier may fine the sender. The
Repair Center acknowledges arrival by email the same business day.

Customers may also drop a product at either showroom. Frederick sends it to Hagerstown on the
Tuesday van; Annapolis does the same. A drop-off at a showroom still needs a WC- number.

## Contacts

Shipping questions from customers go to help@lanternsupply.example or (301) 555-0147. Questions
from agents about a specific package go to the warehouse office line, extension 240, staffed by
Denise Okafor's team from 7:00 AM to 5:00 PM ET on business days.

[4] returns-policy.md > Return authorization numbers
## Return authorization numbers

Every mailed return needs a return authorization number before it ships. RA numbers have the form
RA- followed by six digits, for example RA-118204. The number is printed on the packing slip
that comes with the prepaid label and must also be written on the outside of the box.

Customers obtain an RA number by:

- Using "Start a return" on the online store, which issues the number immediately for any
  eligible order and emails it with a packing slip.
- Calling (301) 555-0147 during support hours. The agent creates the return in Hearth and reads
  the number back.

A package that arrives at the warehouse without an RA number is held for 10 business days while
the warehouse tries to match it to an order. If it cannot be matched it is returned to the sender
at the sender's cost. The RA number is valid for 30 days from issue.

[5] shipping.md > Signature on delivery
### Signature on delivery

Orders over $400 ship with a signature required. The threshold is applied to the merchandise
subtotal. Customers who cannot be present may redirect the package to a UPS Access Point through
the carrier's tracking page. The warehouse does not waive the signature requirement on request.
